description: Add or update a task on the room's shared board. action='add' (title; optional detail, assignee, status) · 'update' (task_id or num; any of title, detail, status todo|doing|done, assignee) · 'remove'. assignee is a member_id or display name ('' to unassign). Every change shows in the room feed and on the watch page.

assignee.description: member_id or display name of who does it; '' to unassign

num.description: The task's number on the board (alternative to task_id)

name: room_task
title: Add or update a task
